title: The app has a mind of its own.
body:

I was out of the challenge for such a stupid reason. Unbelievable.

A whole year later same thing happened, I was going for perfect month. I closed the calorie ring on Wednesday, I saw it with my own eyes, I checked on that day and even got a notification saying I closed, fast forward 2 days later it says I only burned 165 calories, but both my works had 199 calories burned (I use Zepp and Strava, so this was the same workout).
